text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Original fantasy magic-academy moon courtyard rendered in expressive East Asian ink wash and restrained mineral pigments, crescent-shaped stone arch, quiet circular shallow pool and ancient golden ginkgo tree, closed study alcoves, moon silver and azurite blue, atmospheric ink diffusion, no writing or runic text, no figures.
